calculation.description: Measures whether the most recent five-day return is above or below the prior four-week average daily pace; the validated negative IC indicates that unusually strong recent acceleration tends to mean-revert over the next day.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC/ICIR: 2020-22 -0.05236/-0.14265; 2023-24 -0.04181/-0.11051; 2025-26 -0.02782/-0.07653. Negative sign is intentional and represents acceleration exhaustion. Small cross-asset universe; uncertainty interpreted conservatively.
